**Finding submitted: deviation (EXCLUSIVITY).**

- **Responsive clause:** § 2.2 (p0013) appoints Vendor as Customer's "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — full-term exclusive dealing with no category limit, no 12-month cap, and no performance-based exit (walk-away territory; fails all four fallback elements).
- **Other locations checked:** § 2.1 (no minimum/purchase commitment) and § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges no exclusivity commitment) support us but conflict with 2.2 and do not override it; there is no precedence clause that resolves the conflict in our favour (the duplicate 2.2 precedence provision ranks only amendments/Order Forms/exhibits above the Agreement). All other "exclusive" hits (13.1 non-exclusive licence, 19.4, 21.4, 28.2, 30.2) are unrelated or in our favour.
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** single surgical replace making the appointment non-exclusive and confirming Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation — curing the operative restriction and its internal conflict without touching unrelated text.
